Just learned 'access fatigue' 🤯

meaning: the effects of constantly having to explain, teach, & reinvent access. This demand wears us down, shapes how we see ourselves, and makes pushing for inclusion harder. 

It IS exhausting. I'm so glad I have the vocabulary for this now.

#DisabilityJustice
